prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1253; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my name on it yet, if that's okay. I can answer the questions.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was making a left turn across the opposite lane.

Q: What were the weather and road conditions like?

A: It was clear and dry. Traffic was moderate, nothing unusual for that time of day.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you began the turn.

A: I had my signal on and I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. I saw a vehicle a fair distance away, so I started to go. Then a car came through the intersection much faster than I expected and hit the driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle's signal or speed before you started the turn?

A: No, I didn't see a signal. I glanced at the oncoming lane and judged it was clear enough.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck snapped back and I've had stiffness and pain since then. My shoulder hurts when I turn my head to check traffic.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?

A: I went to urgent care that same day, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?

A: Only that I was trying to be careful. I didn't cut anyone off, and I'd like the damage to my car and my medical bills looked at fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Okay, thank you.
